title: Türkiye first, then Kenya's Wild Loop
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX **Sat Dec 19** → Türkiye → Nairobi → LAX **Sat Jan 16**. Christmas in Türkiye; Kenya from Dec 28 is the Wild loop unchanged.
- **Stopover:** 3 nights Istanbul, 4 in Göreme cave hostel; balloon tries, valley hikes. On existing TK route: flights ~+$150 pp. All-in ~$2,760 pp (~+$1,260 over Kenya-only).
- **Verdict:** Easiest, cheapest stopover: on TK route, no visa, short transfers, Christmas among rock churches. Weak wildlife (birds, cats), cold grey winter, ~50/50 balloon odds per morning.
- **Safety:** US State Dept Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (page dated Jun 9 2026). Do not travel to southeast Türkiye or the Syria/Iraq border region.. Istanbul + Cappadocia: Level 2, far from no-go southeast. Risks: terrorism in crowds, protests, anti-US mood since Feb 28 2026 US–Iran hostilities, scams; Consulate Adana drawn down (off-route). Practical: icy trails, balloon operator choice; re-check advisory pre-departure.
- **Cost:** $8,860 pp, **+$1,260** vs the Wild loop alone ($7,600).

**Highlights:** Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı: all walkable from Sultanahmet · Şehir Hatları Bosphorus ferry (~$10–20): two continents, shearwaters, cormorants, slim dolphin chance · Christmas Day at Göreme Open Air Museum + Dark Church (10th–12th c. frescoes) · 4 dawn balloon chances, or free view of ~100 balloons rising · Easy–moderate hikes: Rose, Red, Love, Pigeon valleys to Uçhisar castle, maybe snow · Night in carved cave room · Green Tour: Derinkuyu underground city (8 levels) + Ihlara canyon walk · No visa, shortest flights; on TK routing, ASR→IST→NBO protected on one ticket

**Drawbacks:** Weakest wildlife: mostly birds, off-peak at Sultan Sazlığı. Fails 'wildlife first'. · Cold, grey: Cappadocia mornings below freezing, Istanbul drizzly. · Balloons fly ~50–60% of mornings; 4 tries, no guarantee. Book full refund if all cancelled. · Balloon ~$180 pp winter (~$100–330); comfort baskets more; ground view free. · Christmas–New Year busy; book cave rooms early. · More volatile since Feb 2026 US–Iran hostilities; still Level 2, anti-US sentiment up. · Long Dec 27: shuttle, domestic flight, ~3h layover, 6h45 to NBO, land ~01:25; Dec 28 rest day. · Istanbul fees high, in euros: Topkapı ~€55, Cistern ~€38, Hagia Sophia €25. · Upgrades: boutique cave hotel $150–300/room/night vs ~$80; guide ~$150/day; Pamukkale doesn't fit.

### Then Kenya (Wild loop)
- **Route (one camping crew, all road):** Nairobi → Ol Pejeta 2n → **Samburu 3n** (NYE) → Thomson's Falls 1n → Lake Nakuru 2n → **Kakamega rainforest 2n** → Kericho 1n → **Mara conservancy 4n** → Naivasha + Hell's Gate 2n → airport hotel → fly home.
- **Exotic wildlife focus:** Samburu's Special Five + vulturine guineafowl, chimps + black rhino (Ol Pejeta), Rothschild's giraffe (Nakuru), colobus + De Brazza's monkeys + great blue turaco (Kakamega), big cats (Mara). See **Wildlife**.
- **No beach, no rental car:** crew 4x4 + driver-guide included.
- **Budget: ~$7,600 pp** (incl. flights + $300 contingency). Crew days are the cost driver.
- **Cuts:** skip Kakamega (−$800), home Jan 14 (−$450), yellow fever done (−$200), fly out of the Mara (−$90).
- **Fatigue:** max ~4.5h road/day, overnight stops split every long leg, 9 zero-travel days. Last day is a ~25h journey home.

itinerary.title: Depart LAX
itinerary.details: TK10 ~19:45 nonstop, ~13h. Sleep; set watches +11h.

itinerary.title: Arrive Istanbul
itinerary.details: Land IST ~19:00. Bus/metro/taxi to Sultanahmet ~1.25–1.5h. Check in, short walk to lit Blue Mosque, sleep.
itinerary.meals: Meals on the plane; light late dinner near the hostel (döner, pide)

itinerary.title: Old City on foot
itinerary.details: All walking. Hagia Sophia at opening (€25), Blue Mosque (free, modest dress), Basilica Cistern (~€38, card only), Hippodrome. Afternoon: Grand Bazaar. Early night.
itinerary.meals: Hostel breakfast; simit and street-food lunch; lokanta dinner

itinerary.title: Bosphorus + Topkapı
itinerary.details: Topkapı + Harem ~€55; closed Tuesdays (Dec 22 is Tue), so swap with Dec 21. Afternoon: Şehir Hatları ferry from Eminönü (~1.5h each way, cheap): shearwaters, cormorants, maybe dolphins. Or ferry to Kadıköy food market. Spice Bazaar on return.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; balık-ekmek (fish sandwich) at Eminönü; meyhane dinner in Kadıköy

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.details: Bus ~1.25h + flight ~1.5h + shuttle ~1h ≈ 3.75h plus airport time. Check into cave room; walk to Sunset Point. Confirm balloon pickup.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; airport snack; testi kebab (pottery-pot stew) dinner

itinerary.title: Balloon #1 + Red/Rose Valley
itinerary.details: ~05:30 pickup, ~1h flight, ~50–60% odds; if cancelled, watch from roof. Late morning: Rose/Red Valley loop ~3–4h, easy–moderate, icy spots, sunset view. Christmas Eve dinner.
itinerary.meals: Cave breakfast spread; packed lunch; Christmas Eve dinner out

itinerary.title: Christmas among rock churches
itinerary.details: Dawn: balloon backup. Open Air Museum (€20) + Dark Church (€6), ~2–3h, 15-min walk. Afternoon: Love/Pigeon Valley to Uçhisar Castle ~2–3h; bus/taxi back ~15 min. Relaxed.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; gözleme lunch; dinner in Uçhisar or Göreme

itinerary.title: Green Tour: Derinkuyu + Ihlara
itinerary.details: Dawn: balloon backup. 09:30 minibus (~$45–80 with lunch; check entries, Derinkuyu ~€13): Derinkuyu, Ihlara river walk ~1.5h, Selime monastery. ~2.5h driving total; back ~17:30.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; lunch included by the river; easy dinner

itinerary.title: Fly to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Dawn: last balloon backup/viewpoint. Shuttle ~1h, ASR→IST ~1h35, ~3h connection, TK607 18:40 → NBO 01:25 Dec 28 (~6h45). Dec 28 rest day.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; lunch at the airport; dinner on board

itinerary.title: Land + rest day
itinerary.details: Land early morning (see Route). Taxi (~20m) to guesthouse (room held from Dec 27). Sleep. Optional: Sheldrick baby elephants 11:00 ($20, ~20m away; book online now).

itinerary.title: Drive north to Ol Pejeta
itinerary.details: Crew pickup ~08:30. ~4h via Nanyuki, equator stop. Camp set at OPC campsite. PM: chimp sanctuary + sunset drive.

itinerary.title: Rhinos + Mt Kenya
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late drives. Black/white rhino, lion, elephant, Grevy's zebra. Optional lion tracking (~$70; not budgeted).

itinerary.title: North to Samburu + NYE by the river
itinerary.details: ~2.5–3h via Nanyuki + Isiolo; drop into hot, dry north. Camp on the Ewaso Ng'iro river. PM drive. Quiet NYE under the stars.

itinerary.title: Samburu Special Five
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late drives: Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, gerenuk, Beisa oryx, Somali ostrich. Vulturine guineafowl, river elephants. Midday siesta (30–35°C).

itinerary.title: Leopards + river day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Search riverine forest for leopard; lions, cheetah possible. Optional Samburu village visit (~$20–30 pp, paid locally).

itinerary.title: Back to the cool highlands
itinerary.details: ~3.5h via Isiolo + Nanyuki. Thomson's Falls (74 m) walk to the bottom. Camp at the falls; cool night (fleece).

itinerary.title: Short hop to Nakuru
itinerary.details: ~1.5h downhill to Lake Nakuru NP. Camp inside the park. PM drive: rhino, Rothschild's giraffe.

itinerary.title: Nakuru day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn drive to Baboon Cliff. Black + white rhino, flamingos/pelicans (numbers vary), tree-climbing lions if lucky. Siesta.

itinerary.title: West to the rainforest
itinerary.details: ~4–4.5h via Eldoret. Rondo Retreat inside the forest, full board. Dusk walk: colobus calling.

itinerary.title: Rainforest day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn bird walk with local guide (~Ksh300–500 pp): great blue turaco, hornbills. Black-and-white colobus, De Brazza's + red-tailed monkeys. Lirhanda Hill. Optional night walk (pottos, bushbabies).

itinerary.title: Tea country
itinerary.details: ~2.5–3h via Kisumu. Tea-estate walk, factory visit. Easy afternoon.

itinerary.title: Into the Mara conservancy
itinerary.details: ~3–3.5h via Bomet + Mulot (last hour rough). Camp in Enonkishu (or Pardamat/Ol Chorro). Dusk drive.

itinerary.title: Full Mara day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late drives, off-road, few vehicles. Big cats, plains game, newborn topi. Siesta.

itinerary.title: Maasai walk + night drive
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Morning walk with Maasai ranger. PM drive. Night drive if allowed (aardvark, bat-eared fox, genets).

itinerary.title: Extra Mara day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Full-day drive with picnic lunch, following whatever the guides found. Sundowner.

itinerary.title: Road to Naivasha
itinerary.details: ~4–4.5h via Narok + Mai Mahiu. Lakeshore camp. Hippos at dusk.

itinerary.title: Hell's Gate + boat
itinerary.details: No long travel (30m local). Bike or walk Hell's Gate among zebra + giraffe, gorge hike. PM boat + Crescent Island walk. Rest.

itinerary.title: Airport hotel
itinerary.details: ~2.5–3h via A104 + Southern Bypass. Tip crew. Shower, repack, early night.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Wake ~02:45, 10–20m to JKIA. TK608 04:50 → IST 11:45. ~2h45 airside connect. TK9 ~14:30 → LAX ~18:15 same day. ~25h door to door.

practical:
## Türkiye stopover
- **Visa (US passport):** US passport: visa-free tourism, 90 days per 180 (since early 2024; no e-visa). Passport valid 6 months past stay (safe choice). Kenya eTA still needed.
- **Safety — US State Dept Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (page dated Jun 9 2026). Do not travel to southeast Türkiye or the Syria/Iraq border region.:** Istanbul + Cappadocia: Level 2, far from no-go southeast. Risks: terrorism in crowds, protests, anti-US mood since Feb 28 2026 US–Iran hostilities, scams; Consulate Adana drawn down (off-route). Practical: icy trails, balloon operator choice; re-check advisory pre-departure.
  - Enroll STEP; re-check travel.state.gov week before (advisory updated twice in 2026).
  - Low profile as Americans: skip demos/political gatherings; no posts criticizing Turkish state.
  - Exit plan without US govt help; TK ticket out of IST is built-in exit.
  - Alert in crowds: Sultanahmet, Istiklal, bazaars, transit hubs, holidays/New Year.
  - Sultanahmet scams: dropped shoe brush, 'let's have a drink' bars, carpet hard sells. Use BiTaksi/metered taxi.
  - Balloons: SHGM-licensed, well-reviewed only; accept weather calls; avoid anyone flying when others grounded.
  - Traction spikes/grippy boots (Rose, Red, Love valleys ice over); offline map (Maps.me/AllTrails).
  - Secure passports. Basilica Cistern: card/Istanbulkart only, no cash.
- **Weather in late Dec:** Istanbul ~5–11°C, grey, damp, windy; rain ~1 day in 2; sunset ~16:40. Cappadocia ~−3 to 5°C, freezing nights, possible snow, icy trails. Balloons fly ~50–60% of mornings (unverified); plan 4 dawns. Pack layers, hat, gloves, waterproof boots (also for Kenya dawn drives).

## Entry
- Kenya eTA $30, **etas.gov.ke only**. Türkiye: airside connections only, no visa needed. Passport 6+ mo, 2 blank pages.

## Flights
- TK10 19:45→19:00+1. TK607 **20:30 → 03:05**. 1.5h connect: tight. Missed → next night; Ol Pejeta 1n shorter.
- Return Jan 16: TK608 04:50 → IST 11:45, ~2h45 airside connect, TK9 ~14:30 → LAX ~18:15. Check times when booking; keep ≥2h connect.

## Do we need a rental car? No.
- Safari days: the camping operator's 4x4 + driver-guide is in the crew price. You never drive.
- Self-drive is possible (e.g. Roadtrip Africa Land Cruisers + rooftop tent), but **Mara conservancies don't allow self-drive vehicles**, you'd do every 4–5h drive yourselves on the left, and an 8-day self-drive package starts ~€1,730 pp: not cheaper.
- Nairobi: Uber/Bolt. Everything else in the crew vehicle.

## Road reality
- Longest days: Dec 29 (~4h), Jan 6 (4–4.5h), Jan 13 (4–4.5h). Rest day before each.
- Samburu → Nakuru and Kakamega → Mara are split with overnights (Thomson's Falls, Kericho).
- Kericho → Mara via Mulot: last hour rough; ask operator about rain.

## Weather
- Samburu hot + dry (30–35°C days). Kakamega: afternoon showers, muddy trails: rain jacket + closed shoes. Highlands cold at night.


## Fees
- KWS Nakuru $90 new vs $60 old (court case). OPC + Mara conservancies not KWS. Cashless (card/M-Pesa).

## Operator must confirm in writing
- Mara conservancy mobile camping allowed + fee. Per-day rate incl. festive days. No hidden repositioning.

## Health (CDC)
- Yellow fever recommended outside Nairobi. Malaria pills from Dec 27 to 7 days after leaving Kenya (Kakamega/west is higher risk). DEET.

## Camping
- Walk-in tents, beds, bucket shower, toilet tent. Askari at night. Laikipia/Nakuru nights ~8–12°C: fleece.

## Money/safety
- ~130 KES/$. Crisp USD for tips. Kenya Level 2: Uber/Bolt, no night walks. Plastic bags banned.

fatigue_check:
**Türkiye stopover (Dec 19–28):**
Dec 19: ~13h flight (overnight). Dec 20: arrive ~19:00, ~1.25–1.5h road. Dec 21: 0h. Dec 22: 0h road (ferry ~3h RT, seated). Dec 23: ~3.75h door to door (1.25h road + 1.5h flight + 1h road). Dec 24: 0h (3–4h hike). Dec 25: 0h (2–3h hike). Dec 26: ~2.5h road, spread out. Dec 27: 1h road + 1.6h flight + ~3h layover + 6.75h flight, land NBO 01:25 Dec 28 (~12h). Dec 28: Nairobi rest. Pace rules met: max ~2.5h road/day; easy days after arrival and before Dec 27; rest day after.

**Kenya (from Dec 28):**
Door-to-door travel per day:
- Dec 26–27 | flights (~13h + 6.5h) | long-haul
- Dec 28 | 20m taxi at 03:30 | REST
- Dec 29 | ~4h road | medium (after rest day)
- Dec 30 | 0 | REST
- Dec 31 | 2.5–3h road | light
- Jan 1–2 | 0 | REST ×2
- Jan 3 | ~3.5h road | medium
- Jan 4 | ~1.5h road | light
- Jan 5 | 0 | REST
- Jan 6 | 4–4.5h road | long (after rest day)
- Jan 7 | 0 | REST
- Jan 8 | 2.5–3h road | light
- Jan 9 | 3–3.5h road | medium
- Jan 10–11 | 0 | REST ×2
- Jan 12 | 0 | REST (extra Mara day)
- Jan 13 | 4–4.5h road | long (after 3 Mara rest days)
- Jan 14 | ~30m local (Hell's Gate) | REST-ish
- Jan 15 | 2.5–3h road | light

Rules:
- **Max ~5h road:** met; longest 4–4.5h.
- **No back-to-back ≥3.5h:** met.
- **Rest days:** 9 with no transfer (incl. easy Hell's Gate day) + arrival rest day.
- 1-night stops are transit: Thomson's Falls, Kericho, airport.
- Jan 16 is the one hard day: sleep early Jan 15; sleep on the long flight.

prelude.safety: Istanbul + Cappadocia: Level 2, far from no-go southeast. Risks: terrorism in crowds, protests, anti-US mood since Feb 28 2026 US–Iran hostilities, scams; Consulate Adana drawn down (off-route). Practical: icy trails, balloon operator choice; re-check advisory pre-departure.
prelude.visa: US passport: visa-free tourism, 90 days per 180 (since early 2024; no e-visa). Passport valid 6 months past stay (safe choice). Kenya eTA still needed.
prelude.weather: Istanbul ~5–11°C, grey, damp, windy; rain ~1 day in 2; sunset ~16:40. Cappadocia ~−3 to 5°C, freezing nights, possible snow, icy trails. Balloons fly ~50–60% of mornings (unverified); plan 4 dawns. Pack layers, hat, gloves, waterproof boots (also for Kenya dawn drives).
prelude.verdict: Easiest, cheapest stopover: on TK route, no visa, short transfers, Christmas among rock churches. Weak wildlife (birds, cats), cold grey winter, ~50/50 balloon odds per morning.
